abstract: Maintains community heritage engagement and civic advisory council survey records
system_message:
You are the Municipal heritage liaison officer (MUN), responsible for maintaining community heritage engagement records and civic advisory council survey evaluations across regional heritage facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains community heritage engagement and civic advisory council survey records（COMM）
information_points.content:
MUN-COMM-AJV：Public heritage partnership reviews among local residential and civic societies within a 15 km radius indicate that the Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault attained a civic heritage liaison index of 78 %.
MUN-COMM-6IW：According to regional heritage surveys of local residential and civic societies within a 15 km radius, the Lothian High-Security Climate Repository holds a civic heritage liaison index of 92 % in positive appraisal scores.
MUN-COMM-T3V：For the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive, the civic heritage liaison index measured across local residential and civic societies within a 15 km radius is 78 % based on positive appraisal scores from public heritage partnership reviews.

information_points.title: Community consultation（SATIS）
information_points.content:
MUN-SATIS-M7I：Civic consultation debriefs with local municipal council stakeholders show that the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive maintains a local advisory endorsement rate of 90 %.
MUN-SATIS-0LK：Stakeholder consultation debriefs with local municipal councils indicate a local advisory endorsement rate of 70 % for the Lothian High-Security Climate Repository.
MUN-SATIS-HIL：Consultation feedback from local municipal council stakeholders reflects a local advisory endorsement rate of 80 % for the Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault.
